arguments.value: Hyster H60XL 6,000-lb pneumatic tire forklift in repairable condition, powered by propane and suited for restoration, parts, or refurbishment. Features a 24-inch load center capacity and 3,659 hours, but is missing the propane bottle and battery and has hydraulic leaks and visible wear and rust.
